positive: A design needs a cohesive palette, color ramp, semantic tokens, or contrast repair
A theme needs source color roles
negative: The request is only to map existing semantic tokens between light, dark, or forced-colors themes
The request is for typography, spacing, or layout without color decisions

exclusions: Do not deliver an unmeasured palette
Do not use raw color values as component contracts

outputs.primary: A brief-derived OKLCH ramp and semantic color-token system with measured pair evidence

stop_conditions: Pause when the required foreground-background roles are unknown
Do not claim accessibility without measured real pairs
